scope.internal/frontend/php8512_diagnostics.bi: Grammar-derived action, reduction, transition, token-name and diagnostic-action metadata for error reporting and bounded grammar-depth checks.
Offsets and dimensions of the immutable grammar data.
scope.internal/frontend/diagnostics.go: Independent bounded Go diagnostic recognizer with PHP token display and bracket rules.

modifications: Convert Bison displacement tables to sorted sparse rows; no C parser skeleton, AST builder, Zend allocator or execution engine is included.
Retain the designated operands for identifier and modifier diagnostics, halt behavior, and encoding-action markers.
The Go parser retains its own AST construction; larger inputs first replay the grammar to preserve PHP stack exhaustion and error order. The runtime does not use these tables.
